test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

 A double-edged sword

options.text: A decision with both advantages and disadvantages

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. A decision with both advantages and disadvantages. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"A double-edged sword"** refers to a situation, decision, or action that has both positive and negative consequences. (दोधारी तलवार) • **Example:** Social media is a double-edged sword; it connects people but can also lead to misinformation. • This idiom is often used to describe scenarios where an advantage can also lead to drawbacks, symbolized by a sword that can harm from both edges. (दोधारी तलवार का अर्थ है कुछ ऐसा जो लाभकारी होने के साथ-साथ नुकसानदायक भी हो सकता है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. A decision with both advantages and disadvantages. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A harmless situation **(हानिरहित स्थिति): Refers to a situation that does not cause harm or damage. • **Example:** The joke she made was light-hearted and created a harmless situation. • **Option 3: A sharp weapon **(तीखा हथियार): Refers to a physical object with a sharp edge used for cutting or combat. • **Example:** The chef used a sharp weapon to slice the vegetables finely. • **Option 4: A final opportunity **(अंतिम अवसर): Refers to a last chance to do something or achieve success. • **Example:** This exam is my final opportunity to pass the semester. 31:Tb5d, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Manages expenses carefully.
